responsibility: Provides the target-independent base configuration shared by VxWorks and VxWorks AE ports. It defines common placeholder spec macros for libraries/startfiles, establishes VxWorks-wide ABI type rules such as wchar_t and wint_t, selects DWARF2 debugging and unwind defaults, adjusts label restrictions for older VxWorks variants, disables unsupported facilities like profiling and libm requirements, and supplies common variant-identification macros. This header is the foundational VxWorks OS fragment that higher-level vxworks.h and vxworksae.h build upon.
